title: No Projectile Random
description: No Projectile Random is a plugin that removes the projectile randomness with lots of features
body:
## **Features:**
- Enabling/Disabling projectile randomness for specific players or the whole server

- Enabling/Disabling projectile randomness for dispensers (meanwhile it's still on workings)

- Enabling/Disabling projectiles

## **Commands:**
- "/pr false|true {username}|server"
false - disables projectile randomness for the specified.
true - enables projectile randomness for the specified.

- "/pr dispensers false|true"
false - making dispensers unaffected by this plugin.
true - making dispensers affected by this plugin.

- "/pr projectile {projectile} false|true"
false - making the specified projectile unaffected by this plugin.
true - making the specified projectile affected by this plugin.
